title: Remove it (no script for this one)

steps.title: Stop the stack
steps.note: Containers go, volumes stay. Bring it back up and you find your models and conversations where you left them.

steps.title: Decide about the models
steps.note: This is the one that hurts: tens of gigabytes you would have to download again. Keep it unless you are short on disk.

steps.title: Erase the rest
steps.cmd: docker volume rm echohub_userdata echohub_ateliers echohub_searxng
steps.note: Conversations, workshop files and search configuration. Then docker rmi echohub:v2 echohub-atelier:v2 for the images.
